introHtml: EMT embroidered patches offer a durable, professional way to identify your emergency medical team. Unlike standard patches, these are built to withstand frequent washing and rugged daily use, making them ideal for uniforms, bags, and gear. Available in custom shapes and sizes, they can be decorated with your department logo or unit number using high-density embroidery. Perfect for volunteer squads, fire departments, or hospital emergency services ordering in bulk.
